Exercise: One-Arm Kettlebell Snatch

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
expert

Movement Patterns:

- pull_push

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings
- lower back
- traps
- triceps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC and glycolytic

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- improving_hip_and_knee_mobility
- building_shoulder_strength
- developing_explosive_power

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Lower back pain or injury

Exercise Variations:

- name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Snatch, equipment: kettlebells
- name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean and Press, equipment: kettlebells

Substitution Options:

- name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Snatch, equipment: dumbbells
- name: Kettlebell Clean and Press, equipment: kettlebells

Instructions:

- Place a kettlebell between your feet. Bend your knees and push your butt back to get in the proper starting position.
- Look straight ahead and swing the kettlebell back between your legs.
- Immediately reverse the direction and drive through with your hips and knees, accelerating the kettlebell upward. As the kettlebell rises to your shoulder rotate your hand and punch straight up, using momentum to receive the weight locked out overhead.
